title: Usage reports will include a user ID column starting December 1
author: Allison
description: Starting December 1, 2026, usage reports that include a username column will also include a user_id column next to it. Every column after username will move one position to the… The post Usage reports will include a user ID column starting December 1 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Starting December 1, 2026, usage reports that include a username column will also include a user_id column next to it. Every column after username will move one position to the right.
takeaways: This change applies to the detailed usage report, the AI usage report, and the premium request usage report, including exports you create with the GitHub REST API.
These changes apply to all GitHub Enterprise Cloud account types and standalone organizations on GitHub Team.
What you need to do If your scripts or tools read these reports by column position, update them to read columns by header name before December 1.
